# Termux-Train (v1.0.0)
> Ultra-Lightweight On-Device Tensor & DAG Autograd Deep Learning Framework

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-train
- Installation: `pip install termux-train`
- Architecture: Implements a pure C++/Python dynamic computation DAG with SafeTensors zero-copy serialization and memory-mapped LoRA backpropagation on ARM64.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import termux_train as tt

# 1. Define model with LoRA layers
model = tt.nn.TransformerLoRA(vocab_size=32000, dim=512, lora_rank=8)
optimizer = tt.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4)

# 2. Train on-device with zero memory overhead
for epoch in range(5):
    loss = model(inputs, targets)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    print(f"Epoch {epoch}: Loss = {loss.item():.4f}")

```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
